mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decline and SPX returns is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized), a decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) signals deteriorating consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines during a recession (GDPC1 growth < 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% monthly) signals rising consumer spending power that boosts demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1 annualized growth > 1.5%) signals sustained economic expansion that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals improving labor market conditions that increase consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.0%.
